```{r}
## ---- Setup ----
# install.packages(c("data.table","dplyr","ggplot2","pheatmap"), dependencies = TRUE)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# Paths to your files (adjust if needed)
expr_file  <- "TNBC_expression_matrix.csv"      # genes x TNBC samples (you created earlier)
pheno_file <- "TNBC_full_sample_info.csv"       # sampleID, ER/PR/HER2, PAM50, etc.

## ---- Load data ----
expr_df  <- fread(expr_file)           # first column = gene symbol, rest = samples
pheno_df <- read.csv(pheno_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# standardize IDs to TCGA-XX-XXXX format with dashes (just in case)
pheno_df$sampleID <- gsub("\\.", "-", pheno_df$sampleID)

# figure out the gene column name (often "sample" in Xena exports)
gene_col_name <- colnames(expr_df)[1]
colnames(expr_df)[1] <- "Gene"

# keep only samples that appear in both expression & phenotype
expr_samples <- setdiff(colnames(expr_df), "Gene")
common <- intersect(expr_samples, pheno_df$sampleID)

if (length(common) < 5) {
  message("Heads up: fewer than 5 TNBC samples matched between expression and phenotype. Check ID formats.")
}
# subset & order columns: Gene + common samples
expr_df <- expr_df[, c("Gene", common), with = FALSE]

# align phenotype to expression column order
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>% filter(sampleID %in% common)
pheno_df <- pheno_df[match(common, pheno_df$sampleID), ]

## ---- Build numeric matrix ----
# rownames = gene symbols; remove duplicated/missing gene names
expr_df <- expr_df[!is.na(expr_df$Gene) & expr_df$Gene != "", ]
expr_df <- expr_df[!duplicated(expr_df$Gene), ]

mat <- as.matrix(expr_df[, -1, with = FALSE])
mode(mat) <- "numeric"
rownames(mat) <- expr_df$Gene

# quick sanity checks
cat("Matrix dimensions (genes x samples):", paste(dim(mat), collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("Phenotype rows:", nrow(pheno_df), " (should equal # samples)\n")

## ---- QC: basic distribution & sample-level summary ----
# per-sample median expression (simple outlier check)
sample_meds <- apply(mat, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
print(summary(sample_meds))

# boxplot (log scale already in data, but this shows spread); may be heavy for many genes
# boxplot(as.data.frame(mat), outline = FALSE, las = 2, main = "Per-sample expression distribution")
## ---- Variance filtering for exploration ----
# keep top 1000 most variable genes for PCA/heatmap
gene_var <- apply(mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
top_n <- 1000
keep_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(top_n, length(gene_var)))]
mat_var <- mat[keep_genes, ]

## ---- Optional grouping: PD-L1 (CD274) High vs Low ----
# create a simple biology-based color for plots even though all are Basal
group <- rep("Unknown", ncol(mat_var))
names(group) <- colnames(mat_var)

if ("CD274" %in% rownames(mat)) {
  cd274 <- mat["CD274", ]
  cutoff <- median(cd274, na.rm = TRUE)  # median split
  group[cd274 >= cutoff] <- "PD-L1_high"
  group[cd274 <  cutoff] <- "PD-L1_low"
} else {
  message("CD274 not found; grouping will remain 'Unknown'.")
}

# Add PAM50 (should be Basal-like for all, but keep for completeness)
annot <- data.frame(
  sampleID = pheno_df$sampleID,
  PAM50    = pheno_df$PAM50Call_RNAseq %||% pheno_df$PAM50_mRNA_nature2012,
  Group    = group[pheno_df$sampleID],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
row.names(annot) <- annot$sampleID
annot$sampleID <- NULL

## ---- PCA ----
# prcomp expects samples as rows -> transpose
pca <- prcomp(t(mat_var), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca$x),
  PC1 = pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca$x[,2],
  Group = annot[rownames(pca$x), "Group"],
  PAM50 = annot[rownames(pca$x), "PAM50"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
head(pca_df)

# Plot PCA (colored by PD-L1 group)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, label = Sample, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "PCA of Basal TNBC (top variable genes)",
       subtitle = "Colored by PD-L1 (CD274) median-split",
       color = "Group")

## ---- Heatmap ----
# scale rows (genes) for visualization
ann_colors <- list(
  Group = c("PD-L1_high" = "#1f77b4", "PD-L1_low" = "#ff7f0e", "Unknown" = "grey70"),
  PAM50 = c("Basal-like" = "#d62728", "Luminal A"="#2ca02c", "Luminal B"="#9467bd",
            "HER2-enriched"="#8c564b", "Normal-like"="#bcbd22")
)

pheatmap(mat_var,
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         annotation_col = annot,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         main = "Basal TNBC — Heatmap of Top Variable Genes")

## ---- Save key outputs ----
write.csv(pca_df, "TNBC_PCA_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Optionally save the top-variable matrix used for plots
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = rownames(mat_var), mat_var, check.names = FALSE),
          "TNBC_topVariableMatrix.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Done. Files saved: TNBC_PCA_scores.csv, TNBC_topVariableMatrix.csv\n")

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)   # needed for autoplot(prcomp)

## ---- PCA + Heatmap in one PDF ----

# 1. Perform PCA on your TNBC expression subset
pca_res <- prcomp(t(mat_var), scale. = TRUE)

# 2. Build PCA plot (color by PD-L1 group)
p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Group, label = Sample)) +

       theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
       labs(title = "PCA of Basal TNBC (top variable genes)",
            subtitle = "Colored by PD-L1 (CD274) median split",
            color = "Group")

# 3. Open a PDF device
pdf("TNBC_PCA_Heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

# 4. Print PCA plot (page 1)
print(p)

# 5. Print Heatmap (page 2)
pheatmap(mat_var,
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         annotation_col = annot,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         main = "Basal TNBC — Heatmap of Top Variable Genes")

# 6. Close PDF device
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Load packages
library(limma)
library(edgeR)

# 1. Expression matrix (already subset to TNBC)
# exp_mat : genes x samples (20530 x 76)
# pheno   : data.frame with sampleID and Group (PDL1_high / PDL1_low)

# Make sure columns match between expression and phenotype
all(colnames(mat) == pheno_df$sampleID)

# 2. Create DGEList object (limma-voom works well with RNAseq log2 normalized data too)
dge <- DGEList(counts = mat)

# 3. Experimental design
pheno_df$Group <- factor(pheno_df$Group, levels = c("PDL1_low", "PDL1_high"))
design <- model.matrix(~ Group, data = pheno_df)
colnames(design) <- c("Intercept", "PDL1_high_vs_low")

# 4. Apply voom transformation (stabilizes variance)
v <- voom(dge, design, plot = TRUE)

# 5. Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(v, design)

# 6. Apply empirical Bayes moderation
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# 7. Get DEG results
deg_results <- topTable(fit,
                        coef = "PDL1_high_vs_low",
                        number = Inf,
                        adjust.method = "BH")

# Save to CSV
write.csv(deg_results,
          "TNBC_PDL1_DEG_results.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

# 8. Quick summary
summary(decideTests(fit))

```

```{r}
colnames(design)

# Assuming 'fit' is your limma object after eBayes
deg <- topTable(fit, coef = "PDL1_high_vs_low", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
head(deg)


# Add a column for significance
deg_results$Significance <- "Not Sig"
deg_results$Significance[deg_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_results$logFC > 1] <- "Up"
deg_results$Significance[deg_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_results$logFC < -1] <- "Down"

# Volcano plot
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(deg_results, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot of DEGs",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# --- Adjust thresholds as needed ---
logFC_cutoff <- 1      # change to 2 if you want stricter cutoff
adjP_cutoff  <- 0.05   # change to 0.01 if you want stricter cutoff

# Add significance category
deg$Significance <- "Not Sig"
deg$Significance[deg$logFC >= logFC_cutoff & deg$adj.P.Val < adjP_cutoff] <- "Up"
deg$Significance[deg$logFC <= -logFC_cutoff & deg$adj.P.Val < adjP_cutoff] <- "Down"

# Order by adjusted p-value to pick top genes
top_genes <- deg[order(deg$adj.P.Val), ][1:10, ]   # top 10 most significant

# Volcano plot with labels
volcano <- ggplot(deg, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down" = "blue", "Not Sig" = "grey", "Up" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_cutoff, logFC_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(adjP_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(label = rownames(top_genes)),
                  size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot of DEGs",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save high-res
ggsave("Volcano_Plot_DEGs.png", volcano, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Volcano_Plot_DEGs.pdf", volcano, width = 8, height = 6)

# --- Export DEG tables ---
up_deg   <- subset(deg, Significance == "Up")
down_deg <- subset(deg, Significance == "Down")

write.csv(up_deg, "Upregulated_genes.csv")
write.csv(down_deg, "Downregulated_genes.csv")
write.csv(deg, "All_DEGs.csv")
```

```{r}
# List of immune checkpoint genes you want to highlight
genes_of_interest <- c("CD274", "PDCD1", "CTLA4", "LAG3", "TIGIT")

# Top 10 significant DEGs (up or down)
top_sig <- deg[deg$Significance != "Not Sig", ]
top_sig <- top_sig[order(top_sig$adj.P.Val), ][1:10, ]

# Pull out checkpoint genes regardless of significance
checkpoints <- deg[rownames(deg) %in% genes_of_interest, ]

# Combine both
label_genes <- rbind(top_sig, checkpoints)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(deg, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down" = "blue", "Up" = "red", "Not Sig" = "grey")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label_genes,
                  aes(label = rownames(label_genes)),
                  size = 3, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 50)

ggsave("volcano_plot.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(maftools)
# Load packages
install.packages(c("data.table", "dplyr"))
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# URL for the public BRCA MC3 MAF
maf_url <- "https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/mc3%2FBRCA_mc3.txt.gz"

# Read gzipped MAF directly from URL
maf <- fread(cmd = paste("curl -s", maf_url))
head(maf)

# Filter mutations: only PASS and coding (optional: adjust Variant_Classification)
maf_filtered <- maf %>%
  filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  filter(Variant_Classification %in% c(
    "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins",
    "Splice_Site", "Nonstop_Mutation", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins"
  ))

# Count mutations per sample
tmb_counts <- maf_filtered %>%
  group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
  summarise(Mutation_Count = n())

# Normalize by exome size (~38 Mb)
exome_size_mb <- 38
tmb_counts <- tmb_counts %>%
  mutate(TMB = Mutation_Count / exome_size_mb)

# View TMB
head(tmb_counts)

# Optional: save result
write.csv(tmb_counts, "BRCA_TMB.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
```{r}
# Load packages
#install.packages(c("data.table", "dplyr", "ggplot2"))
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# URL for the public BRCA MC3 MAF
maf_url <- "https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/mc3%2FBRCA_mc3.txt.gz"

# Read gzipped MAF directly from URL
maf <- fread(cmd = paste("curl -s", maf_url))
head(maf)
colnames(maf)

# Count all mutations per sample
tmb_counts <- maf %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(Mutation_Count = n()) %>%
  mutate(TMB = Mutation_Count / 38)  # 38 Mb exome

# View TMB
head(tmb_counts)

# Save TMB table
write.csv(tmb_counts, "BRCA_TMB.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot TMB distribution
ggplot(tmb_counts, aes(x = TMB)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "TMB Distribution in TCGA-BRCA Cohort",
       x = "Tumor Mutational Burden (mutations/Mb)",
       y = "Number of Samples")
```

```{r}
# ---- packages ----
#nooooinstall.packages(c("openxlsx","dplyr"))
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)


# ---- settings ----
infile  <- "TNBC_expression_matrix.csv"   # <- CSV file
outfile <- "TNBC_expression_for_CIBERSORTx.txt"

# If your matrix is log2(TPM + 1), set this TRUE to back-transform to TPM.
backtransform_log2_TPMp1 <- FALSE

# ---- read ----
# Assumes first column = gene symbols
expr <- read.csv(infile, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# rename first column to GeneSymbol
colnames(expr)[1] <- "GeneSymbol"

# remove empty gene symbols if any
expr <- expr %>% filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol), GeneSymbol != "")

# ---- handle duplicates: keep the row with highest median across samples ----
num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(expr), "GeneSymbol")
expr_dedup <- expr %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(.med = median(c_across(all_of(num_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(GeneSymbol, desc(.med)) %>%
  distinct(GeneSymbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-.med)

# ---- optional: back-transform from log2(TPM+1) to TPM ----
if (backtransform_log2_TPMp1) {
  expr_dedup[, num_cols] <- lapply(expr_dedup[, num_cols], function(x) {
    (2^as.numeric(x)) - 1
  })
}

# ---- drop genes with all zeros ----
all_zero <- apply(expr_dedup[, num_cols], 1, function(v) all(is.na(v) | v == 0))
expr_final <- expr_dedup[!all_zero, ]

# ---- write CIBERSORTx input (tab-delimited) ----
write.table(expr_final, outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

cat("Wrote:", outfile, "\nRows (genes):", nrow(expr_final), "Cols (samples):", ncol(expr_final)-1, "\n")

```
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Load raw expression matrix
expr_raw <- read_csv("TNBC_expression_matrix.csv")

# Check first column name
head(expr_raw[[1]])

# Ensure first column is called "GeneSymbol"
colnames(expr_raw)[1] <- "GeneSymbol"

# Remove junk rows (like NAs or empty symbols)
expr_clean <- expr_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol), GeneSymbol != "")

# If multiple rows per gene, keep the row with highest median expression
expr_final <- expr_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(.med = median(c_across(-GeneSymbol), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(GeneSymbol, desc(.med)) %>%
  distinct(GeneSymbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-.med)

# Save final file
write_tsv(expr_final, "TNBC_expression_CIBERSORTx_ready.txt")
```

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Read your raw expression file (CSV from Excel)
expr_raw <- read_csv("TNBC_expression_matrix.csv")

# Rename the first column to GeneSymbol
colnames(expr_raw)[1] <- "GeneSymbol"

# Save as tab-delimited .txt (CIBERSORTx prefers tab format)

write.table(expr_raw, 
            file = "TNBC_expression_CIBERSORTx_ready.txt",
            sep = "\t", 
            row.names = FALSE, 
            quote = FALSE)
test <- read.delim("TNBC_expression_CIBERSORTx_ready.txt", 
                   check.names = FALSE)
dim(test)        # should match your original (genes × samples)
head(test[,1:5]) # first few genes and samples


cat("✅ File saved: TNBC_expression_CIBERSORTx_ready.txt\n")
```

```{r}
        col = rainbow(22), 
        border = NA,
        las = 2, 
        cex.names = 0.6,
        ylab = "Cell Fraction",
```

```{r}
cd274_expr <- as.data.frame(t(cd274_expr))

# TMB file (sample-wise TMB values)
tmb <- read.csv("BRCA_TMB.csv")
colnames(tmb)
# TCGA clinical data

clin <- read.table("BRCA_clinicalMatrix.txt", 
                   header = TRUE, 
                   sep = "\t", 
                   quote = "", 
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
clin$SampleID_short <- substr(clin$sampleID, 1, 15)
colnames(clin)
# ================================
# Step 2. Harmonize Sample IDs
# ================================
# For TCGA, keep only first 12 characters of barcode
clean_id <- function(x) substr(x, 1, 12)

rownames(cd274_expr) <- clean_id(rownames(cd274_expr))
rownames(immune)     <- clean_id(rownames(immune))
tmb$SampleID         <- clean_id(tmb$sample)
clin$SampleID        <- clean_id(clin$sampleID)
dim(cd274_expr)
summary(cd274_expr$CD274)

#MAIN WORK HERE NOT THE BELOW
merged_data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by="SampleID"),
                      list(cd274_expr, immune, tmb, clin))
dim(merged_data)
colSums(is.na(merged_data))

#KEPT IT JUST IN CASE
cd274_expr$SampleID <- rownames(cd274_expr)
head(cd274_expr)
immune$SampleID <- rownames(immune)
merged_data <- merge(cd274_expr, immune, by = "SampleID")
dim(merged_data)
merged_data <- merge(merged_data, tmb, by = "SampleID")
dim(merged_data)
merged_data <- merge(merged_data, clin, by = "SampleID")
dim(merged_data)
colSums(is.na(merged_data))







analysis_df <- merged_data[, c(
  "SampleID",
  "CD274",
  "TMB",
  "T.cells.CD8",
  "OS_Time_nature2012",
  "OS_event_nature2012",
  "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis",
  "pathologic_stage"
)]

dim(analysis_df)
colSums(is.na(analysis_df))


#CHECK DISTRIBUTIONS
summary(analysis_df$CD274)
summary(analysis_df$TMB)
summary(analysis_df$T.cells.CD8)

#CORRELATION
cor.test(analysis_df$CD274, analysis_df$T.cells.CD8, method="spearman")
cor.test(analysis_df$CD274, analysis_df$TMB, method="spearman")
#This tells you:
#Is PD-L1 linked to CD8 infiltration?
#Is PD-L1 linked to mutation burden?

#KAPLAN-MEIER SURVIVAL
analysis_df$PDL1_group <- ifelse(
  analysis_df$CD274 > median(analysis_df$CD274),
  "High",
  "Low"
)
#P VALUES NOT SIGNIFICANT, SHOWS THAT TMB IS NOT DEPENDENT ON PDL1 .
boxplot(analysis_df$TMB)
analysis_df$TMB_log <- log2(analysis_df$TMB + 1)
#plot
library(survival)
library(survminer)

fit <- survfit(
  Surv(OS_Time_nature2012, OS_event_nature2012) ~ PDL1_group,
  data = analysis_df
)

km_plot<-ggsurvplot(fit, data = analysis_df,pva1=TRUE)
print(km_plot)

#log rank grouping 
coxph(

)

#km style visualization

)

#To do IDO2 vs immune
```
